findings.summary: At HEAD 522b8947, OD-C4-009 says it was adopted at 2026-10-19T23:43Z. That is later than the decision's own manifest time (23:42:32Z) and later than the commit that records it (20:42:39-0300, which is 23:42:39Z).
findings.failure_scenario: An auditor rebuilding the timeline sees the decision timestamped after the commit that recorded it. The worktree has an uncommitted, unreviewed edit that reduces the timestamp to the date only. It is not part of HEAD, so it should be committed and reviewed (or replaced with the manifest's exact time) before anyone relies on it.
